versos.grego: Αὐτὸς δὲ ἐγὼ Παῦλος παρακαλῶ ὑμᾶς διὰ τῆς πραΰτητος καὶ ἐπιεικείας τοῦ Χριστοῦ, ὃς κατὰ πρόσωπον μὲν ταπεινὸς ἐν ὑμῖν, ἀπὼν δὲ θαρρῶ εἰς ὑμᾶς·

controles.web: Now I Paul, myself, entreat you by the humility and gentleness of Christ; I who in your presence am lowly among you, but being absent am bold toward you.
controles.kjv: Now I Paul myself beseech you by the meekness and gentleness of Christ, who in presence am base among you, but being absent am bold toward you:
controles.livre: Além disto eu mesmo, Paulo, pela mansidão e bondade de Cristo, vos rogo, (eu que em verdade sou humilde entre vós quando presente, porém ousado para convosco quando ausente);

versos.grego: δέομαι δὲ τὸ μὴ παρὼν θαρρῆσαι τῇ πεποιθήσει ᾗ λογίζομαι τολμῆσαι ἐπί τινας τοὺς λογιζομένους ἡμᾶς ὡς κατὰ σάρκα περιπατοῦντας.

controles.web: Yes, I beg you that I may not, when present, show courage with the confidence with which I intend to be bold against some, who consider us to be walking according to the flesh.
controles.kjv: But I beseech you, that I may not be bold when I am present with that confidence, wherewith I think to be bold against some, which think of us as if we walked according to the flesh.
controles.livre: Rogo pois, que quando eu estiver presente, não tenha que mostrar ousadia com a confiança de que penso que terei de me mostrar ousado para com alguns que nos consideram como se andássemos segundo a carne.

versos.grego: Ἐν σαρκὶ γὰρ περιπατοῦντες οὐ κατὰ σάρκα στρατευόμεθα,

controles.web: For though we walk in the flesh, we don’t wage war according to the flesh;
controles.kjv: For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh:
controles.livre: Pois ainda que andemos na carne, não batalhamos segundo a carne.

versos.grego: τὰ γὰρ ὅπλα τῆς στρατείας ἡμῶν οὐ σαρκικὰ ἀλλὰ δυνατὰ τῷ Θεῷ πρὸς καθαίρεσιν ὀχυρωμάτων, λογισμοὺς καθαιροῦντες

controles.web: for the weapons of our warfare are not of the flesh, but mighty before God to the throwing down of strongholds,
controles.kjv: (For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;)
controles.livre: Porque as armas de nossa batalha não são carnais, mas sim poderosas em Deus, para destruirmos fortalezas;

versos.grego: καὶ πᾶν ὕψωμα ἐπαιρόμενον κατὰ τῆς γνώσεως τοῦ Θεοῦ, καὶ αἰχμαλωτίζοντες πᾶν νόημα εἰς τὴν ὑπακοὴν τοῦ Χριστοῦ,

controles.web: throwing down imaginations and every high thing that is exalted against the knowledge of God, and bringing every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ;
controles.kjv: Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ;
controles.livre: Assim destruímos pensamentos e toda arrogância que se levanta contra o conhecimento de Deus, e levamos como prisioneiro todo pensamento para a obediência a Cristo.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐν ἑτοίμῳ ἔχοντες ἐκδικῆσαι πᾶσαν παρακοήν, ὅταν πληρωθῇ ὑμῶν ἡ ὑπακοή.

controles.web: and being in readiness to avenge all disobedience, when your obedience will be made full.
controles.kjv: And having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled.
controles.livre: E estamos prontos para vingar toda desobediência, quando vossa obediência for completa.

versos.grego: Τὰ κατὰ πρόσωπον βλέπετε. εἴ τις πέποιθεν ἑαυτῷ Χριστοῦ εἶναι, τοῦτο λογιζέσθω πάλιν ἐφ’ ἑαυτοῦ, ὅτι καθὼς αὐτὸς Χριστοῦ, οὕτως καὶ ἡμεῖς.

controles.web: Do you look at things only as they appear in front of your face? If anyone trusts in himself that he is Christ’s, let him consider this again with himself, that, even as he is Christ’s, so also we are Christ’s.
controles.kjv: Do ye look on things after the outward appearance? If any man trust to himself that he is Christ’s, let him of himself think this again, that, as he is Christ’s, even so are we Christ’s.
controles.livre: Olhais as coisas pela aparência? Se alguém confia de si mesmo que é de Cristo, pense o tal outra vez consigo mesmo que, assim como ele é de Cristo, assim também nós somos de Cristo.

versos.grego: ἐάν τε γὰρ περισσότερόν τι καυχήσωμαι περὶ τῆς ἐξουσίας ἡμῶν, ἧς ἔδωκεν ὁ Κύριος εἰς οἰκοδομὴν καὶ οὐκ εἰς καθαίρεσιν ὑμῶν, οὐκ αἰσχυνθήσομαι,

controles.web: For though I should boast somewhat abundantly concerning our authority, (which the Lord gave for building you up, and not for casting you down) I will not be disappointed,
controles.kjv: For though I should boast somewhat more of our authority, which the Lord hath given us for edification, and not for your destruction, I should not be ashamed:
controles.livre: Porque se eu também ainda mais me quiser orgulhar do nosso poder que o Senhor nos deu para edificação, e não para vossa destruição, não me envergonharei;

versos.grego: ἵνα μὴ δόξω ὡς ἂν ἐκφοβεῖν ὑμᾶς διὰ τῶν ἐπιστολῶν.

controles.web: that I may not seem as if I desire to terrify you by my letters.
controles.kjv: That I may not seem as if I would terrify you by letters.
controles.livre: Para que não pareça que eu queira vos amedrontar por meio de cartas.

versos.grego: ὅτι Αἱ ἐπιστολαὶ μέν, φησίν, βαρεῖαι καὶ ἰσχυραί, ἡ δὲ παρουσία τοῦ σώματος ἀσθενὴς καὶ ὁ λόγος ἐξουθενημένος.

controles.web: For, “His letters”, they say, “are weighty and strong, but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech is despised.”
controles.kjv: For his letters, say they, are weighty and powerful; but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech contemptible.
controles.livre: Porque eles dizem que as cartas são em verdade graves e fortes, mas a presença do corpo é fraca, e a palavra desprezível.

versos.grego: τοῦτο λογιζέσθω ὁ τοιοῦτος, ὅτι οἷοί ἐσμεν τῷ λόγῳ δι’ ἐπιστολῶν ἀπόντες, τοιοῦτοι καὶ παρόντες τῷ ἔργῳ.

controles.web: Let such a person consider this, that what we are in word by letters when we are absent, such are we also in deed when we are present.
controles.kjv: Let such an one think this, that, such as we are in word by letters when we are absent, such will we be also in deed when we are present.
controles.livre: Pense isto o tal, que assim como somos na palavra por cartas quando ausentes, assim também seremos por obra quando estivermos presentes.

versos.grego: Οὐ γὰρ τολμῶμεν ἐνκρῖναι ἢ συνκρῖναι ἑαυτούς τισιν τῶν ἑαυτοὺς συνιστανόντων· ἀλλὰ αὐτοὶ ἐν ἑαυτοῖς ἑαυτοὺς μετροῦντες καὶ συνκρίνοντες ἑαυτοὺς ἑαυτοῖς οὐ συνιᾶσιν.

controles.web: For we are not bold to number or compare ourselves with some of those who commend themselves. But they themselves, measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves with themselves, are without understanding.
controles.kjv: For we dare not make ourselves of the number, or compare ourselves with some that commend themselves: but they measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves among themselves, are not wise.
controles.livre: Porque não ousamos a nos classificar ou comparar com alguns que louvam a si mesmos; mas estes tem falta de entendimento ao medirem a si mesmos consigo mesmos, e ao compararem a si mesmos consigo mesmos.

versos.grego: ἡμεῖς δὲ οὐκ εἰς τὰ ἄμετρα καυχησόμεθα, ἀλλὰ κατὰ τὸ μέτρον τοῦ κανόνος οὗ ἐμέρισεν ἡμῖν ὁ Θεὸς μέτρου, ἐφικέσθαι ἄχρι καὶ ὑμῶν.

controles.web: But we will not boast beyond proper limits, but within the boundaries with which God appointed to us, which reach even to you.
controles.kjv: But we will not boast of things without our measure, but according to the measure of the rule which God hath distributed to us, a measure to reach even unto you.
controles.livre: Nós, porém, não nos orgulharemos além da medida, mas sim conforme a medida da extensão que Deus repartiu conosco, medida que também vos alcança.

versos.grego: οὐ γὰρ ὡς μὴ ἐφικνούμενοι εἰς ὑμᾶς ὑπερεκτείνομεν ἑαυτούς, ἄχρι γὰρ καὶ ὑμῶν ἐφθάσαμεν ἐν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ τοῦ Χριστοῦ·

controles.web: For we don’t stretch ourselves too much, as though we didn’t reach to you. For we came even as far as to you with the Good News of Christ,
controles.kjv: For we stretch not ourselves beyond our measure, as though we reached not unto you: for we are come as far as to you also in preaching the gospel of Christ:
controles.livre: Porque em nada estendemos além do que devíamos, como se não tivéssemos vos alcançado; pois fomos nós os primeiros a vir até vós no Evangelho de Cristo;

versos.grego: οὐκ εἰς τὰ ἄμετρα καυχώμενοι ἐν ἀλλοτρίοις κόποις, ἐλπίδα δὲ ἔχοντες αὐξανομένης τῆς πίστεως ὑμῶν ἐν ὑμῖν μεγαλυνθῆναι κατὰ τὸν κανόνα ἡμῶν εἰς περισσείαν,

controles.web: not boasting beyond proper limits in other men’s labors, but having hope that as your faith grows, we will be abundantly enlarged by you in our sphere of influence,
controles.kjv: Not boasting of things without our measure, that is, of other men’s labours; but having hope, when your faith is increased, that we shall be enlarged by you according to our rule abundantly,
controles.livre: Não nos orgulhamos além da medida no trabalho de outros, mas temos esperança de que, quando vossa fé crescer, seremos engrandecidos abundantemente entre vós conforme nossa extensão;

versos.grego: εἰς τὰ ὑπερέκεινα ὑμῶν εὐαγγελίσασθαι, οὐκ ἐν ἀλλοτρίῳ κανόνι εἰς τὰ ἕτοιμα καυχήσασθαι.

controles.web: so as to preach the Good News even to the parts beyond you, not to boast in what someone else has already done.
controles.kjv: To preach the gospel in the regions beyond you, and not to boast in another man’s line of things made ready to our hand.
controles.livre: Para pregarmos o evangelho em outros lugares além de vós; e não na extensão de outros pregadores , para nos orgulharmos de coisas que já estavam prontas.

versos.grego: Ὁ δὲ καυχώμενος ἐν Κυρίῳ καυχάσθω·

controles.web: But “he who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”
controles.kjv: But he that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.
controles.livre: Porém o que se orgulha, se orgulhe no Senhor.

versos.grego: οὐ γὰρ ὁ ἑαυτὸν συνιστάνων, ἐκεῖνός ἐστιν δόκιμος, ἀλλὰ ὃν ὁ Κύριος συνίστησιν.

controles.web: For it isn’t he who commends himself who is approved, but whom the Lord commends.
controles.kjv: For not he that commendeth himself is approved, but whom the Lord commendeth.
controles.livre: Porque não é o que louva a si mesmo, mas sim o que louva ao Senhor; esse é o aprovado.
